title: Deep learning-based malaria parasite detection: convolutional neural networks model for accurate species identification of Plasmodium falciparum and Plasmodium vivax.
summary: The seven-channel model reports species classification performance on held-out test data. A CNN classifies P. falciparum, P. vivax and uninfected cells from thick-smear image channels. Testing: Five-fold cross-validation and a separate testing dataset provide the source-described diagnostic validation, without implying clinical deployment.. The open Nature article's Methods and Results establish a CNN for species-level malaria parasite classification in thick smears, with held-out testing and five-fold cross-validation; this is a bounded retrospective diagnostic-validation result. Source affiliation was not stated in the reviewed case checks and was unavailable in the local bibliographic cache.
